body.prompt: Editorial storybook illustration for a Korean finance explainer video. Hand-drawn deep navy ink linework with soft watercolor wash on warm ivory paper texture, limited palette of navy, ivory and muted gold with small warm accents, gentle light, clear single focal point, calm and intelligent mood, generous empty space around the subject. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Scene: Bird's-eye view of a night city drawn like a map: thin glowing delivery routes run from hundreds of tiny restaurants and all converge into one narrow gate in the center. A giant hand reaches in from across the ocean at the top edge of the frame and takes hold of the gate, a faint red suspension bridge silhouette far away on the other shore.
